learning_goals: Understand, compare, and implement the specified optimisation algorithms with their assumptions and convergence limits.
target_depth: Second-year mathematical and algorithmic treatment with stated conditions and short executable evidence.
proof_depth: Interpret theorem conditions and explain their role; no full proof development.
assumptions_requiring_review: An optimisation objective is not necessarily physical energy.
An algorithmic iteration is not necessarily physical time evolution.
Formal convex optimisation is new background.
